title: Component C Runtime Bundle (Phase 2, minimal)
description: Manifest for the Component C runtime artefacts a session would pin to. Deliberately minimal: Phase 2 needs only the generator wheel pin, the catalogue artefact pin, the bundle's own approval status, and compatibility metadata. Every Component B-only block (bkt_configuration, certification_configuration, guess_guard_configuration, safe_progress_policy, attempt_policy, timeout_policy, completion_policy, cold_start_policy) is intentionally absent -- none of those are Component C concepts, and copying their structure (or B's frozen sequencing weights) here would record meaning that does not exist for C. Later phases (policy/safety/scaffold config pins) extend this schema when they actually need to, under their own authorization -- this file is not a forward-looking template. schema_version 1.1 (Phase 4b) adds ONE such extension, selection_configuration -- the repository's FIRST schema version bump, additive-only: a 1.0 bundle with no selection_configuration block still validates under 1.1. selection_configuration carries the FULL seven-field component_c_generator.selection.config.CSelectionConfig (owner ruling: carry all seven, not only the window -- see the selectionConfiguration $def's own description for the full field-by-field provenance). REPUBLISH COST: whoever edits a bundle manifest to add or change ANY of selection_configuration's seven fields is re-publishing the WHOLE bundle -- the generator pin and the catalogue pin are re-attested in the same act, not edited in isolation. There is no precedent in this repository for a schema version bump; this is the first one, and its additive-only shape is established here, not inherited.

schema_version.description: 1.1 exists only to add the OPTIONAL selection_configuration block below; every other 1.0 requirement is unchanged. A bundle need not declare 1.1 to omit selection_configuration -- both versions accept its absence.

immutable_after_publication.description: The persistence and promotion layers must reject mutation after publication. JSON Schema records but cannot itself enforce storage immutability.

database_schema_revision.description: Alembic revision when available; an explicit unresolved placeholder is permitted only while the bundle remains DRAFT.

selection_configuration.description: OPTIONAL (schema_version 1.1, Phase 4b). Absent on every 1.0 bundle and on any 1.1 bundle that has not been republished with it. C-internal only (owner condition 5) -- never serialised into any client-visible response. Its own approval_status carries CALIBRATION_PENDING or whatever status is genuinely true; this schema records that status, not a resolution of it -- no field here names an approver, a date, or an anticipated signatory.

activation_date.description: Null while a bundle is an unapproved draft; a published active bundle requires an externally enforced non-null date-time.

required_catalogue_template_count.description: Component C's own EXPECTED_TEMPLATE_COUNT (component_c_generator.catalogue.loader), not B's 36 -- the two catalogues are unrelated artefacts.

selectionConfiguration.description: Phase 4b, schema_version 1.1. AMENDED from the one-field shape (window only) to carry the FULL component_c_generator.selection.config.CSelectionConfig -- all seven of its required, no-default fields, per the owner's ruling selecting 'carry all seven fields in the bundle block' (widening, not restarting, the earlier work). version/checksum/approval_status remain the governance envelope, structurally mirroring runtime-bundle.schema.json's sequencing_configuration. config_version and parameter_source_status are carried as their OWN independent fields, NOT derived from version/approval_status: CSelectionConfig.parameter_source_status has no closed vocabulary in the package (only non-empty-string validated, no consuming gate anywhere in component_c_generator -- verified against the installed wheel) and its own established convention token ("TEST_FIXTURE_ONLY") does not overlap approvalStatus's governance vocabulary (APPROVED/CALIBRATION_PENDING/...); collapsing the two would be exactly the coercion-across-different-vocabularies this schema must not perform. approval_status stays a pure governance gate value, consumed only by the bundle approval check, never passed into CSelectionConfig. No const anywhere in this block on a CALIBRATION_PENDING field -- a const would be exactly the 'value that could be read as a resolution' this block must never contain; every number here is structurally bounded only (matching the package's own Field(ge=.., le=..) bounds), never a schema constant.

config_version.description: Maps 1:1 to CSelectionConfig.config_version -- same semantic role as this block's own `version`, carried as a separate field because CSelectionConfig requires its own field name.

parameter_source_status.description: Maps 1:1 to CSelectionConfig.parameter_source_status. Deliberately NOT the same field as approval_status above -- see this block's own top-level description for why collapsing them would be a vocabulary coercion.

x-runtime-invariants: Existing sessions remain pinned to their original bundle
Activating a new bundle affects only new sessions
Missing or incompatible required artefacts fail readiness closed
